payload.name: Flypost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flypost is a LinkedIn content creation studio. Create LinkedIn posts, carousels, images and articles in your own voice from ChatGPT, built on your own material, then schedule them to LinkedIn. The plugin connects ChatGPT to your Flypost account, where everything you create is saved to your content plan.

What you can do:
- Brainstorm LinkedIn post ideas based on what has worked on your profile, and save them to your Flypost idea bank. Flypost checks new ideas against the posts you have already published, so you don't repeat yourself.
- Write LinkedIn posts in your voice. ChatGPT reads your Flypost brand kit and writing voice (tone, words to avoid, formatting rules) and searches your saved sources (blog posts, videos, documents, call notes) for real facts, stories and figures to build on.
- Save drafts to Flypost, where you can edit them, add images or carousels, and see them alongside the rest of your content plan.
- Create LinkedIn visuals: carousel slides, infographics and single images in your brand colours and fonts.
- Write long-form LinkedIn articles from a brief.
- Check how human a draft sounds before you post it.
- Schedule posts to LinkedIn, or cancel a scheduled one. ChatGPT asks you to confirm before it schedules or cancels anything.
- Review your recent LinkedIn post analytics to see what is landing.

Who it is for: founders, consultants, marketers and anyone who wants to post on LinkedIn more often and get better results from it, without spending hours writing and planning each post.

Limitations:
- You need a Flypost account. You sign in once in your browser and choose which of your projects to work in.
- Connecting LinkedIn is done in the Flypost app, not in ChatGPT.
- Publishing is LinkedIn only.
- Image, carousel and article generation run in the background and can take a minute; ChatGPT checks on progress for you.
payload.longDescription:
Flypost是领英内容创作工作室，可通过ChatGPT从您自己的素材中生成符合您个人风格的领英动态、轮播图、图片和文章，然后安排发布到领英。该插件将ChatGPT与您的Flypost账户连接，您创建的所有内容都会保存到内容计划中。

您可以：
- 根据个人资料中表现良好的内容生成领英动态创意，并保存到Flypost创意库。Flypost会将新创意与您已发布的帖子进行比对，避免重复创作。
- 用您自己的风格撰写领英动态。ChatGPT会读取您的Flypost品牌资料（包括语气、禁用词汇、格式规则）并搜索您保存的资料库（博客文章、视频、文档、通话记录）中的真实事实、故事和数据进行创作。
- 将草稿保存到Flypost，可编辑内容、添加图片或轮播图，并查看与整体内容计划的关联性。
- 创建领英视觉内容：品牌配色和字体的轮播图幻灯片、信息图和单张图片。
- 根据简报撰写长文型领英文章。
- 在发布前检测草稿的自然度。
- 安排帖子发布或取消已安排的发布，ChatGPT会在执行前向您确认。
- 查看近期领英动态的分析数据，了解内容效果。

适用人群：希望更频繁发布领英内容并获得更好效果的创始人、顾问、营销人员，无需花费大量时间撰写和规划每篇帖子。

使用限制：
- 需要拥有Flypost账户，您可在浏览器中登录一次并选择工作项目。
- 连接领英需在Flypost应用内完成，而非ChatGPT内。
- 发布功能仅支持领英平台。
- 图片、轮播图和文章生成在后台运行，可能需要约1分钟，ChatGPT会为您监控进度。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create LinkedIn posts in your voice, Create carousels and images, Write LinkedIn articles, Save ideas and drafts, Schedule LinkedIn posts

payload.name: Bloomroom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bloomroom is a creative floral design tool for making editable digital 3D arrangements. Explore flower combinations, color palettes and compositions for personal expression or a digital gift. Choose flowers, colors, quantities, containers and scenes from the actual Bloomroom catalog, validate the design, then compile an editable 3D work. Anonymous design needs no Bloomroom account. Editing requires the creation credential; a public viewing link cannot recover it. Temporary draft links expire after 24 hours; sign in on the website to save to an account. Preview SVGs are composition schematics; the studio renders the actual 3D work. Physical delivery, payments, messaging and Bloomroom paid AI generation are not provided.
payload.longDescription:
Bloomroom是一款创意花艺设计工具，可制作可编辑的数字3D花束。
探索花卉组合、色彩搭配和构图，用于个人表达或数字礼物。
从实际的Bloomroom目录中选择花卉、颜色、数量、容器和场景，验证设计后生成可编辑的3D作品。
匿名设计无需Bloomroom账户。
编辑功能需要创建凭证；公开浏览链接无法恢复该凭证。
临时草稿链接在24小时后过期；请登录网站以保存至账户。
预览SVG文件为构图示意图；工作室会渲染实际的3D作品。
不提供实物配送、支付、消息传递及Bloomroom付费AI生成服务。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read catalog, Validate designs, Create anonymous arrangements, Edit own drafts, Read previews

payload.name: BlockGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BlockGPT helps Minecraft players create structures from text descriptions or publicly accessible HTTPS image links. Generate castles, buildings, statues and other designs, choose a size from 50 to 300, and select a preset block palette or a custom list of supported Minecraft blocks. Download completed builds as .schem, .litematic or legacy .schematic files for use with compatible Minecraft tools.

Connect your BlockGPT account to view your remaining build allowance, list saved builds and check generation progress. Completed results include a link to the build on BlockGPT and a schematic download link. Image input determines the shape; text cannot modify it.

A BlockGPT account is required. The plugin creates downloadable build files; it cannot join a Minecraft server or place blocks in a running world. Direct chat attachment transfer, .nbt export and conversion of existing builds are not supported.
payload.longDescription:
BlockGPT帮助Minecraft玩家通过文本描述或公开可访问的HTTPS图片链接创建结构。
生成城堡、建筑、雕像和其他设计，选择50到300之间的尺寸，并选取预设方块调色板或支持的自定义方块列表。
可下载为.schem、.litematic或旧版.schematic文件，用于兼容的Minecraft工具。

将BlockGPT账户连接至查看剩余建筑额度、列出保存的建筑并查看生成进度。
完成结果包含BlockGPT上的建筑链接和结构图下载链接。
图像输入决定形状；文本无法修改。

需要BlockGPT账户。
该插件生成可下载的建筑文件；无法连接Minecraft服务器或在运行中的世界中放置方块。
不支持直接聊天附件传输、.nbt导出及现有建筑转换。

payload.name: Print Shop by BYB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Got an image you want printed as stickers? Use your ChatGPT created images or drop one into the chat and get a ready-to-order link back, with your artwork already attached.

Bottle Your Brand prints custom die-cut vinyl stickers from your own designs. Upload a PNG, JPG, or PDF, pick a size from 2" to 6", and order as few as 20. Stickers are printed on 7 mil UV-coated vinyl that's waterproof, dishwasher safe, and rated for 5 years outdoors. You'll get a proof with the die line before anything prints, and orders ship within 3 days.

Ask anything about printing while you're at it: what size fits a water bottle or a hard hat, whether your file is high enough resolution, whether you need to add bleed (you don't), or how to get the background off a photo so the sticker cuts to the shape.
payload.longDescription:
有想要印刷成贴纸的图片吗？
可使用ChatGPT生成的图片，或直接拖入聊天窗口，即可获得带有您作品的可直接下单链接。

Bottle Your Brand从您自定义的设计中印刷模切乙烯基贴纸。
上传PNG、JPG或PDF文件，选择2英寸至6英寸的尺寸，最少可订购20张。
贴纸采用7密耳UV涂层乙烯基材质，具有防水特性，可耐受洗碗机清洗，户外使用可达5年。
印刷前会提供带有模切线的样张确认，订单将在3天内发货。

制作贴纸时，您有任何印刷相关问题也可以随时提问：哪种尺寸适合水瓶或安全帽？您的文件分辨率是否足够？是否需要添加出血线（答案是不需要）？或者如何去除照片背景以便贴纸按形状裁剪？

payload.name: Globestudio
payload.description: 点状地图与三维地球仪
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Globestudio makes dotted world maps and animated 3D globes. Ask for a look, a region, colors or data points, and get a link that opens the design in the Globestudio studio at globestudio.app, plus embed code for a website.

What you can do:
- Find a look by style, such as print, retro, glow or synthwave. There are 21 looks.
- Build a globe or flat map of the world, a continent, a subregion or one country, with your own dot color, background, density and dot shape.
- Paste a Globestudio link and change only what you ask for. Every other setting stays.
- Get embed code as an iframe, a React component or a script tag.
- Get the preview image and live embed link for any look.

In a code project, the bundled skill also puts the globe on the page with the @globestudio/react or @globestudio/element packages.

Who it is for: designers, developers and marketers who need a globe or world map for a site hero, a background, a slide or a social post.

Limits: Globestudio builds links and embed code. It does not draw images inside the chat, store designs or need an account. Exports such as PNG, SVG, GLB, MP4, WebM and GIF are made in the studio from the link. It is not a tiled map, routing, geocoding or GIS tool.
payload.longDescription:
Globestudio制作点状世界地图和动态3D地球仪。指定风格、区域、颜色或数据点后，可获得跳转至globestudio.app的链接，以及可嵌入网站的代码。

可实现的功能：
- 通过风格（如印刷风、复古风、发光风或赛博朋克风）寻找视觉效果。共有21种风格。
- 自定义世界、大洲、次区域或单个国家的地球仪或平面地图，支持自定义点色、背景、密度和点形。
- 粘贴Globestudio链接后仅修改您指定的内容，其他设置保持不变。
- 获取iframe、React组件或脚本标签格式的嵌入代码。
- 获取任意风格的预览图和实时嵌入链接。

在代码项目中，配套功能可通过@globestudio/react或@globestudio/element包将地球仪直接渲染到页面中。

适用人群：需要为网站首屏、背景、幻灯片或社交帖子添加地球仪或世界地图的设计师、开发者和营销人员。

使用限制：Globestudio仅生成链接和嵌入代码，不通过聊天窗口绘制图像、存储设计或要求账户登录。PNG、SVG、GLB、MP4、WebM和GIF等格式的导出需在工作室中通过链接完成。它不是瓦片地图、路线规划、地理编码或GIS工具。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find looks by style, Build globe and map links, Edit pasted Globestudio links, Write embed code

payload.name: getimg
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and edit images, videos, music, speech, and sound effects with your getimg account. Use ready-made workflows for professional headshots, photo restoration, stickers, lighting changes, background cleanup, product videos, and UGC ads. Browse your team's media library and reuse previous results as inputs. The existing MCP server provides inline media previews and uploads on supported clients. Sign in to getimg and choose a team when connecting. Generation and editing use that team's credits.
payload.longDescription:
通过您的getimg账户创建和编辑图像、视频、音乐、语音和音效。
使用现成的工作流程制作专业人像摄影、照片修复、贴纸、灯光调整、背景清理、产品视频和UGC广告。
浏览团队的媒体库并将之前的结果作为输入重新使用。
现有MCP服务器可在支持的客户端上提供内联媒体预览和上传。
登录getimg并连接时选择一个团队。
生成和编辑将使用该团队的积分。

payload.name: SnapDub
payload.description: 将长视频转换为短视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SnapDub turns a long recording - a podcast, stream, interview or webinar - into short vertical clips ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

Paste a YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Rumble or Zoom link into the chat and say how many clips you want. SnapDub picks the moments worth clipping from what is said and what is on screen, crops each one to vertical on whoever is speaking, and burns in captions. You get back every clip with its title, virality score, description, hashtags and a download link that is valid for an hour.

What you can do:
- Make clips from a link: how many, how long, captions on or off, captions translated into another language
- Apply your saved SnapDub templates for a consistent look
- Follow a video's progress and list your recent videos
- Read finished clips best-first, ready to post
- Check which SnapDub account is connected
- Look up live clipping campaigns from brands and creators

Who it is for: clippers, creators and small teams who turn long videos into short posts.

Limitations: you need a SnapDub account. The source must be a public link from a supported site. Processing takes a few minutes. Posting to social accounts and AI dubbing are done in the SnapDub app, not from the chat.
payload.longDescription:
SnapDub可将长时长录音（播客、直播、采访或网络研讨会）转换为适合TikTok、Reels和Shorts的垂直短视频。

将YouTube、Twitch、Kick、Rumble或Zoom链接粘贴到聊天窗口，说明需要制作的短视频数量。
SnapDub会从对话内容和屏幕画面中挑选值得剪辑的片段，根据发言者自动裁剪为竖版画面，并添加字幕。
您将获得每个短视频的标题、病毒传播评分、描述、话题标签以及有效期为1小时的下载链接。

可执行操作：
- 从链接制作短视频：设置数量、时长、开启/关闭字幕、将字幕翻译为其他语言
- 应用已保存的SnapDub模板实现统一视觉风格
- 跟踪视频处理进度并查看最近制作的视频
- 优先浏览优质剪辑内容以便直接发布
- 查看当前连接的SnapDub账户
- 查阅品牌和创作者的实时剪辑活动

适用人群：将长视频剪辑为短内容的剪辑师、创作者和小型团队。

使用限制：需要拥有SnapDub账户。
源视频必须为支持网站的公开链接。
处理需要几分钟时间。
发布社交账号和AI配音功能需在SnapDub应用内完成，而非通过聊天窗口。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make vertical clips from a video link, List finished clips with titles, scores and hashtags, Apply saved templates, Find live clipping campaigns

payload.name: Fenestra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fenestra brings architectural rendering into ChatGPT. Share a hand sketch, a screenshot from SketchUp, Rhino or Revit, a massing model, or a photo of a building, room or garden. Say what you want, and Fenestra returns a finished render in the conversation.

What you can do:
- Render a sketch or a 3D screenshot as a photoreal image that keeps your geometry and camera.
- Edit a render or a photo: change the time of day, season, materials, furniture or planting while the design stays as it is.
- Enhance an image to 2K or 4K for a client presentation without redrawing the design.
- Animate a render into a short video with a camera move, or from your original image to the finished render.
- Roast a design: a score, a verdict and three pointed notes, followed by a render that fixes them.

Every result appears in a Fenestra card beside the image you started from, so you can compare the two side by side or with a slider. Results are saved to your Fenestra account, so you can open them in Fenestra and keep working. The card shows which project and workspace your work goes to, and you can change either from the card or by asking.

Fenestra is built for architects, interior designers and landscape designers. It follows the composition of your drawing instead of inventing a new building, and it keeps every image and video you make in one place.

Renders and videos use the credits in your Fenestra account. You sign in with your Fenestra account the first time you connect, and you can create one during that sign-in.
payload.longDescription:
Fenestra将建筑渲染带入ChatGPT。上传手绘草图、SketchUp/Rhino/Revit的截图、体量模型，或建筑、房间、花园的照片。说出你的需求，Fenestra将在对话中返回最终渲染效果。

你可以实现以下操作：
- 将草图或3D截图渲染为保留原始几何结构和视角的逼真图像
- 编辑渲染图或照片：在不改变设计原貌的前提下调整昼夜时段、季节特征、材质、家具或绿植
- 将图像提升至2K/4K分辨率用于客户演示，无需重新绘制设计
- 将渲染图制作成带镜头移动的短视频，或展示从原始图像到最终渲染的演变过程
- 对设计方案进行点评：获得评分、结论和三点具体建议，随后生成改进后的渲染图

所有结果会以Fenestra卡片形式显示在原始图像旁，支持并排对比或通过滑块切换查看。结果会保存到你的Fenestra账户，可随时在Fenestra中打开继续编辑。卡片会显示当前项目和工作区信息，既可通过卡片修改，也可通过指令调整。

Fenestra专为建筑师、室内设计师和景观设计师打造。它遵循你图纸的构图逻辑而非重新构建建筑，所有生成的图像和视频都会集中保存在统一空间中。

渲染和视频将消耗你的Fenestra账户信用点。首次连接时需使用Fenestra账户登录，注册过程可同步完成。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Render sketches and 3D screenshots as photoreal images, Edit materials, lighting, season, planting and furniture in a render or photo, Enhance renders and photos to 2K or 4K without changing the design, Animate a render into a short video, Roast a design and render a fixed version

payload.name: GHEM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GHEM helps creators and businesses produce product images and videos from written descriptions and visual references. Connect your GHEM account, choose a supported model and settings, approve each generation, and view or save the result. Upload reference files, reuse named products and characters, and organize your work into projects. Reference files must be selected in the GHEM upload view or imported from a supported direct HTTPS link; the plugin does not automatically access chat attachments.
payload.longDescription:
GHEM帮助创作者和企业通过文字描述和视觉参考生成产品图像和视频。
连接您的GHEM账户，选择支持的模型和设置，审核每次生成结果，并查看或保存最终效果。
上传参考文件，复用已命名的产品和角色，并将工作内容整理至项目中。
参考文件需在GHEM上传界面中选择或通过支持的直接HTTPS链接导入；插件不会自动访问聊天附件。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate images, Generate videos, Upload references, Organize projects

payload.name: unsketch
payload.description: 创建、修改、编辑图像和动画
payload.summaryOriginal: 画像・動画を作成、修正、編集
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 商品写真から広告画像や短い動画を作り、会話で修正できます。ChatGPTに添付した画像やテンプレートから生成できます。動画はカット・並べ替え・音声からの字幕作成・字幕ファイルの読み込みに対応し、MP4で保存できます。生成結果は履歴から見返せます。
payload.longDescription: 可通过商品照片生成广告图像或短视频，并通过对话进行修改。也可通过ChatGPT附加的图片或模板生成。支持剪辑、排列顺序、从音频生成字幕、加载字幕文件，可保存为MP4格式。生成结果可从历史记录中查看。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: 画像・動画テンプレート検索, 画像・動画モデルの比較, 画像生成・修正, 動画生成・画像の動画化, 動画の取り込み・編集, 生成履歴・再生・保存

payload.name: Cattalog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and edit product catalogues in your connected Cattalog workspace. Work with spreadsheet data and image libraries, manage reusable layout components, inspect rendered pages, and export PDFs. Edits can overwrite existing content. PDF exports use your workspace export quota. Cattalog cannot purchase products or administer workspace membership through this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
在已连接的Cattalog工作区中创建和编辑产品目录。
使用电子表格数据和图片库，管理可重用的布局组件，检查渲染后的页面，并导出PDF文件。
编辑操作可能覆盖现有内容。
PDF导出会占用工作区的导出配额。
此插件无法通过Cattalog购买产品或管理工作区成员。

payload.name: Wrap
payload.description: 将图片转化为可重复使用的模板
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wrap turns photos into reusable mockup templates. Ask for a realistic scene of any blank product, or share your own photo, and Wrap converts it while you watch. Then add your designs, adjust how they sit on the product, and export the mockup as an image. Your mockups are saved in your Wrap account, so you can reopen them in later chats or on wrap.design.
payload.longDescription: Wrap可将照片转化为可重复使用的模板。您可请求任何空白产品的逼真场景，或上传自己的照片，Wrap将实时为您转换。然后添加您的设计，调整设计在产品上的位置，并将模板导出为图片。您的模板将保存在Wrap账户中，您可在后续聊天中或访问wrap.design时重新打开。

payload.name: Commish
payload.description: 定制生产，或寻找现有产品。
payload.summaryOriginal: Get it made, or find it.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe anything you want made or found, or start from a photo: merch, plush, apparel, shoes, bags, stickers, pins, figures, 3D prints, machined or molded parts, packaging, signs, furniture and more. Commish plans the production route and cost by quantity, guides ChatGPT to create the images manufacturers need from your spec (a realistic reference photo, a views sheet, or your own photo edited to match), and turns the chat into a request for quote with a shareable page and PDF. Find existing or similar products with visual search and shop links, send quote requests to manufacturers (factories and OEMs, self-serve print platforms and independent sellers), or publish an open request any manufacturer can quote on without an account. You compare quotes on landed cost and pay the manufacturer you choose directly.
payload.longDescription:
描述您想要定制或寻找的任何物品，或从照片开始：周边商品、毛绒玩具、服装、鞋子、包袋、贴纸、徽章、人偶、3D打印品、机加工或注塑零件、包装、标识、家具等。

payload.name: Sellify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sellify is an AI ad creative tool. It turns your products into ready-to-run image ads for Facebook and Instagram, and shows you what ads competitors are running so you know what to make. Connect your Sellify workspace to create and research ads from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Look up the products in your workspace, and create or update them.
- Generate sales angles for a product, and pick the ones you want to build ads from.
- Create image ads for a product, including recreating a winning ad from Sellify's winning ads library with your own product, then generate more variations.
- Search Ad Spy for ads by keyword, product, or brand to see what competitors are running.
- Organize generated ads on boards and save ads to your library.
- Search the Sellify Help Centre to learn how a feature works.

Every result includes a link that opens the item in the Sellify app, where you can review it, download it, or keep working.

Who it's for: brands, marketers, media buyers, and creative teams who already use Sellify.

Limitations:
- Requires an existing Sellify account. You sign in and choose one workspace when you connect, and Sellify only acts in that workspace.
- Actions that generate ads, angles, or Ad Spy results use your workspace's existing credits. Each call states the most it may spend, and a daily limit applies to each connection.
- Publishing ads to Meta from Sellify is coming soon. For now, download your ads and upload them in Meta Ads Manager.
- Permanently deleting ads and managing billing are done in the Sellify app, not in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Sellify是一款AI广告创意工具，可将您的产品转化为可直接投放的Facebook和Instagram图片广告，并展示竞争对手正在运行的广告，帮助您明确制作方向。您可连接Sellify工作区，通过ChatGPT创建和研究广告。

您可以：
- 查看工作区中的产品并进行创建或更新
- 为产品生成销售卖点，并选择想要用于广告的方案
- 为产品创建图片广告，包括使用Sellify胜率广告库中的优秀广告模板替换为您的产品后，生成更多变体
- 通过关键词、产品或品牌搜索Ad Spy，查看竞争对手的广告
- 将生成的广告整理到看板并保存至您的资料库
- 搜索Sellify帮助中心了解功能使用方法。

每个结果都包含一个链接，点击后可在Sellify应用中打开该条目，方便您查看、下载或继续编辑。

适用对象：已使用Sellify的品牌、营销人员、媒体购买者及创意团队。

使用限制：
- 需要现有的Sellify账户
连接时您需登录并选择一个工作区，Sellify仅会在该工作区中操作
- 生成广告、卖点或Ad Spy结果的操作会消耗工作区的现有积分
每次调用会显示最大消耗金额，且每个连接设有每日限额
- 通过Sellify向Meta发布广告的功能即将上线
目前需下载广告后手动上传至Meta广告管理平台
- 永久删除广告及管理账单需在Sellify应用内操作，不通过ChatGPT进行。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Manage products, Generate sales angles, Create image ads, Search competitor ads, Organize ads on boards, Search the Help Centre

payload.name: Art Goat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Art Goat is a search tool that helps visual artists find opportunities to apply for that are open, rolling, or with applications opening later: grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls and juried exhibitions, awards, commissions, scholarships, workshops, art jobs and internships. Ask in plain language, for example "ceramics residencies in Europe", "photography grants closing this month", "funded residencies for a painter in New York" or "fellowships for emerging artists", and Art Goat returns matching listings with the deadline, the award or stipend amount on file (for commissions this is the total project budget covering all project costs, not take-home pay; a stipend may be a per-period rate with the period given on the listing), any fee amounts on file, the stored eligibility scope, and a link to the full listing on artgoat.com. Listings come from Art Goat's directory and are shown as filed there, refreshed about every minute; listings with a past deadline are excluded unless marked rolling or deadline to be announced. Art Goat is anonymous to use in ChatGPT (no account or sign-in) and never drafts or edits application materials. Always verify deadline, eligibility and fees on the listing page before applying.
payload.longDescription:
Art Goat是一款搜索工具，帮助视觉艺术家寻找开放、持续或未来开放的申请机会，包括奖学金、驻留项目、研究金、公开征集、评审展览、奖项、委托创作、奖学金、工作坊、艺术工作及实习机会。
用通俗语言提问，例如「欧洲的陶瓷驻留项目」、「本月截止的摄影奖学金」、「纽约地区画家的资助驻留项目」或「面向新锐艺术家的研究金」，Art Goat将返回匹配的列表，显示截止日期、奖项或津贴金额（委托创作项目显示覆盖所有项目成本的总预算，而非实际收入；津贴可能为周期性金额，具体周期会在列表中注明）、任何费用金额、存储的资格范围，以及前往artgoat.com完整列表的链接。
列表来源于Art Goat的目录，按其收录内容展示，每分钟更新一次；过去截止日期的列表将被排除，除非标注为滚动截止或截止日期待公布。
在ChatGPT中使用Art Goat无需账户或登录，且从不代为撰写或编辑申请材料。
请在申请前务必在列表页面核实截止日期、资格要求和费用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search open, rolling or upcoming grants, residencies, fellowships and open calls for visual artists, Filter by medium, type, deadline window, funding on file and where the artist lives, Open one listing's key public details

payload.name: refern Notan Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The refern notan generator turns an image you attach into a notan, a value study for artists: the picture reduced to two to five flat values that show its big light and dark shapes. Artists use a notan to check the value design of a painting, drawing, or photo, and to see why a picture reads well or poorly from a distance.

Attach an image and ask for a notan or a value study. The generator opens in the chat with your image. You can:

- Switch between 2, 3, 4, and 5 values.
- Move the split between light and dark, or let the generator place it automatically.
- Simplify the shapes, like squinting, so small details merge into large masses.
- Compare the notan with the original side by side or with a divider, and flip the image to check the design.
- Save the notan as a PNG.

You can also choose, drop, or paste another image into the generator at any time. The notan is made on your device. An image you attach is resized in memory on refern's server and is not stored.

Made by refern, a desktop app for collecting and organizing visual references.
payload.longDescription:
refern notan生成器会将您附加的图片转换为notan（一种艺术家的价值研究）：将画面简化为两到五个平面值，展现其主要的明暗形状。艺术家通过notan检查绘画、素描或照片的价值设计，并观察图片在远处为何看起来良好或不佳。

附加图片并请求生成notan或价值研究。生成器会在聊天中打开您的图片。您可以：

- 在2、3、4和5个值之间切换。
- 调整明暗分界线，或让生成器自动定位。
- 简化形状，如眯眼观察，使小细节融合成大块区域。
- 将notan与原始图片并排或用分隔线对比，翻转图片检查设计。
- 将notan保存为PNG格式。

您也可以随时选择、拖放或粘贴其他图片到生成器中。notan在您的设备上生成。您附加的图片会在refern的服务器内存中调整大小，且不会被存储。

由refern制作，这是一款用于收集和整理视觉参考资料的桌面应用程序。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make a 2 to 5 value notan from an image, Adjust the value splits and shape simplification, Compare the notan with the original image, Save the notan as a PNG

payload.name: Poolday
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Poolday is an AI video editing platform. With this plugin you brief the Poolday agent from the chat and it does the production work in your Poolday workspace: scripting, footage, voiceover, music, captions, brand kits and rendering. A task runs for minutes in the background. The plugin shows it in a live panel with its status, any question the agent needs answered, and the finished video or image outputs with links to open them in Poolday. You can follow up on a task with a change ("make it 15 seconds", "use the second voice"), answer the agent's questions from the chat, find earlier tasks, and drop files from your computer into the panel so a task can use them. Media already in your Poolday library can be referenced in a brief, and links to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or web pages are fetched by Poolday. Connecting asks you to sign in to Poolday and pick one workspace; everything the plugin does happens in that workspace, as you, within your workspace's permissions and credits.
payload.longDescription:
Poolday是一个AI视频编辑平台。
通过此插件，您可以在聊天中向Poolday代理下达指令，它会在您的Poolday工作区完成制作工作：脚本撰写、素材剪辑、配音、配乐、字幕、品牌素材包及视频渲染。
任务在后台运行数分钟。
该插件通过实时面板展示任务状态，包括代理需要解答的问题，以及完成的视频或图片输出，并附带可打开的链接。
您可以通过修改指令（「缩短至15秒」、「使用第二个配音」）、通过聊天回答代理问题、查找历史任务，以及将电脑文件拖入面板供任务使用。
您Poolday库中的媒体可被引用到简报中，Poolday会抓取YouTube、TikTok、Instagram或网页链接内容。
连接时需要您登录Poolday并选择一个工作区；插件所有操作均在此工作区执行，作为您本人在工作区权限和额度范围内进行。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Start a video or media production task from a brief, Follow a running task in a live panel with its status and outputs, Answer the agent's questions without leaving the chat, Send follow-up changes to a finished task, Find earlier tasks in your workspace, Drop files from your computer into Poolday for a task to use, Reference media already in your Poolday library

payload.name: ScoreStarling
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ScoreStarling is a music conversion and notation workspace for musicians, arrangers and music learners. Move musical content between sound, pictures, documents and score files. Start from an audio or video recording, an image or PDF of sheet music, MIDI, MusicXML, ABC, numbered notation, a lead sheet, or music written in the chat. Turn it into an editable, playable score, then convert it to PDF, SVG/PNG images, MusicXML, MIDI, MP3/WAV audio, ABC, MEI, individual parts or numbered notation. Read and hear the result, compare a source recording with score playback, review uncertain passages, preview edits, apply accepted changes and undo them. Recordings of one instrument or voice, or of solo piano, are free; a band uses credits, and its price is shown before it starts. Sign in with a ScoreStarling account. Uploads are limited to 50 MiB, or 120 MiB for WAV, AIFF or FLAC. Audio and video transcription cover the account’s supported excerpt, up to five minutes; the length limit, and for a band the price, are shown before starting. Automatic transcription and sheet-music reading can contain pitch, rhythm or notation errors, so listening and human review are needed.
payload.longDescription: ScoreStarling 是面向音乐家、编曲人和音乐学习者的音乐转换与记谱工作区。在音频、图片、文档和乐谱文件之间迁移音乐内容。可从音频或视频录音、乐谱图片或PDF、MIDI、MusicXML、ABC、数字记谱法、旋律线或聊天中撰写的音乐开始。将其转换为可编辑可播放的乐谱，再导出为PDF、SVG/PNG图片、MusicXML、MIDI、MP3/WAV音频、ABC、MEI、分谱或数字记谱法。可阅读并聆听结果，对比原始录音与乐谱播放效果，审查不确定段落，预览编辑内容，应用或撤销已接受的修改。单件乐器或人声录音，或钢琴独奏录音免费；乐队作品需消耗积分，开始前会显示价格。使用 ScoreStarling 账户登录。上传文件限制为 50 MiB，WAV、AIFF 或 FLAC 格式为 120 MiB。音频视频转录覆盖账户支持的片段，时长最多五分钟；时长限制及乐队作品价格会在开始前显示。自动转录和乐谱识别可能包含音高、节奏或记谱错误，因此需要人工审核。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Multimodal music conversion, Audio and video transcription, Sheet music and score editing, Notation, audio and image export

Pick up where you left off. Reopen a project, build on earlier results, and use your saved Glif skills to guide the next version.
